Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Roorkee Junior Research Fellowship Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) for project-based research positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available post is Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) under a DBT/Wellcome Trust India Alliance sponsored project.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) position in this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for IIT Roorkee JRF Recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates can directly attend the interview as per the specified schedule.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled for IIT Roorkee JRF?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to take place on 01 October 2026 at the designated institute venue.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Microbiology, Biotechnology, or Life Sciences along with a valid GATE or NET qualification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any preferred experience mentioned for applicants?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates having prior hands-on experience in cloning, construction of deletion mutants, and small RNA related work will be given preference.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly salary offered for the JRF position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Junior Research Fellowship will receive a consolidated monthly salary of ₹37,000/-.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should bring a detailed CV, attested copies of degrees, mark sheets, experience certificates, and valid photo identity proof.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official website of IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: Candidates can visit the official website of the institution at www.iitr.ac.in for any further updates and announcements.
